content: Write a reply to the customer email. Apologise for the delay, explain what your company will do next, and ask for any extra information you need.
answerKey: A strong response acknowledges the delay, gives a clear and realistic plan of action, and asks one or two relevant follow-up questions in polite professional English.
passage: Customer email from M. Ortiz: I ordered a replacement battery for my mobile workstation two weeks ago and was told it would arrive within five working days. It still has not arrived. I need this for work and your support line keeps redirecting me. Please tell me what is happening and how soon you will fix this.
instructions: Write 80-110 words. Reply directly to the customer.
rubric: Acknowledges the delay clearly; offers a credible next step; asks for relevant information; uses appropriate polite workplace English.

content: A senior client has questioned the value of a project your team delivered. Respond to the client, acknowledge the concerns, defend the project outcomes with evidence from the brief, and propose a constructive next step that protects the relationship.
answerKey: A strong response engages directly with the client's concerns, defends the work using specific outcomes from the brief, and proposes a constructive forward-looking step without conceding the project's value.
passage: Project brief excerpt: Over the last quarter, your team delivered a content automation pilot for the client's marketing operations. The pilot produced a 32% reduction in turnaround time and a 19% lift in campaign throughput, both measured against the agreed baseline. The senior client now says they did not see the value and is preparing to deprioritise further investment.
instructions: Speak for 90 to 120 seconds. Address the client's concerns directly, refer to specific outcomes from the brief, and propose a next step.
rubric: Defends outcomes with specific evidence; maintains professional composure; proposes a credible and forward-looking next step; uses precise high-level spoken business English.
